reason: Stage-1 download is blocked in the build environment: the org egress policy denies www.data.go.kr and sillok.history.go.kr (403 CONNECT). The probe requires a sample of the real bulk XML, so it could not run here.
how_to_populate: In an environment with access to the bulk data: `python -m sillok_pipeline download` (set SILLOK_BULK_URL or use --zip), then `python -m sillok_pipeline probe --dir data`. That overwrites this file with the measured level4-id widths, dateOccured types, and king-code letters, and sets gate_passed=true when the '간지' date type is present.
